data.name: ListShape
data.value: Provide the values as a list of { type, value }.

data.name: TooManyValues
data.value: The statement takes up to 10,000 values.

data.name: EntryShape
data.value: Each value is an object with type and value.

data.name: TypeInvalid
data.value: The type is text, number, boolean, date or timestamp.

data.name: ValueNotText
data.value: The value is a text, or null.

data.name: TextBrokenEncoding
data.value: The text has half of a UTF-16 pair or invalid UTF-8, which the database does not store.

data.name: TimestampZoneOnlyPostgres
data.value: The instant with a time zone is only valid in PostgreSQL; {0} stores the instant without a time zone.

data.name: NumberDigits
data.value: The number has {0} digits, and {1} stores up to {2}.

data.name: NumberDigitsDriver
data.value: The number has {0} digits, and {1} stores up to {2} through the driver.

data.name: NumberDouble
data.value: The number exceeds what {0} stores in a DOUBLE.

data.name: FilterMarker
data.value: The filter cannot have a parameter marker ($1 or ?).

data.name: NumberForm
data.value: The number is written like 12, -3.5 or 1e10, with up to 100 characters.

data.name: BooleanForm
data.value: The boolean is true or false.

data.name: DateForm
data.value: The date is yyyy-mm-dd, and it must exist.

data.name: TimestampForm
data.value: The instant is yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss, with up to 6 digits after a dot and, in PostgreSQL, the time zone at the end.

data.name: TextTooLong
data.value: The text can have up to 1,000,000 characters.

data.name: TextHasNul
data.value: The text cannot have the character U+0000.

data.name: TextHalfPair
data.value: The text has half of a UTF-16 pair, which the database does not store.
